objective: Unblock the dedicated Catalog policy workflow after its full-directory update exceeded the historical 2 MiB legacy bridge response limit, without changing DSH compatibility decisions or the full Catalog v2 details.

authorization.request: Make the DSH-Store Desktop marketplace adaptation publishable and launch it through the approved GitHub workflow.

change.behavior: The v1 compatibility bridge omits a per-release declaration only when its existing fallback computes the same effective status; the v2 Catalog detail records remain complete and unchanged.
prohibited: Do not raise the 2 MiB response ceiling.
Do not drop plugin entries or explicit compatible results.
Do not change unknown to incompatible or compatible.
Do not modify DSH source, @deepseek-ai packages, or a real Profile.
Do not send author notifications from this source PR.

healthCheck: Run the full-directory admission and compatibility stress fixture, verify status equivalence in current and historical Catalog validators, run npm run check and npm pack --dry-run, then require exact-head Registry CI before merge.
rollback: Revert only the exact source PR through a CI-checked PR. Git history is the recoverable backup. No Profile, package installation, restart, or author-contact ledger mutation is in scope.
catalogPublication: Separate post-merge fresh policy run. It must bind the then-current main Commit and Registry hashes, create and verify its own short-lived-token PR, and independently pass GitHub Raw, Pages, dsh.store, and dsh-store.cn readback.
